html:
Dear Your Family,

بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ

We request the honour of your presence at the Walima of

Ayaan Siddiqui

Son of

Mr. Imran Siddiqui & Mrs. Nazneen Siddiqui

&

Zoya Rahman

Daughter of

Mr. Farhan Rahman & Mrs. Rubina Rahman

as they begin a new life together, in faith and in love

Scroll

tap to open

With grateful hearts

A Beautiful Beginning

With the blessings of Allah and the duas of both our families, we joyfully invite you to celebrate the Walima of our beloved children as they begin their life together.

Ayaan & Zoya

A date to cherish

Scratch to Reveal

Our celebration begins

YOU'RE INVITED

25th April, 2027 Sunday · 8:00 PM onwards

Scratch with your finger

Save the date

Counting down to

Our Walima night

162DAYS
20HOURS
10MINUTES
20SECONDS

The evening

How the night unfolds

7:30 PM

Arrival & WelcomeSherbet and attar at the door

8:00 PM

Walima ReceptionThe couple's grand entrance

9:00 PM

DinnerA royal feast for our guests

The venue

The Crimson Pavilion

Vibhuti Khand, Gomti Nagar,
Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh 226010

View on Google Maps

With all our hearts

Your duas are our dearest gift

Your presence, your love and your prayers are all we could ever wish for.

بَارَكَ اللّٰهُ لَكُمَا وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكُمَا وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ

Barakallahu lakuma, wa baraka 'alaykuma, wa jama'a baynakuma fi khayr.

Meaning

“May Allah bless you both, shower His blessings upon you, and join you together in goodness.”

Waiting to welcome you

Ayaan & Zoya

25 APRIL 2027 · THE CRIMSON PAVILION

With love, the Siddiqui & Rahman families
